newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon has 10 possible buyers for Amana.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon has 10 possible buyers for Amana.

text.p: Raytheon Co said Monday it had 10 prospective buyers, both domestic and international, for its appliance unit including the Amana brand.

"We have been talking to prospective buyers," Raytheon spokesman Bob McWade told Reuters. "The process continues. We've had strong expressions of interest from more than 10 parties, here and overseas."

The German news magazine Der Spiegel reported over the weekend that Bosch-Siemens Hausgeraete (BSGH), a unit of German industrial group Siemens AG, plans to buy Amana and the applicance group for $700 million, and that BSGH management had approved the plan.
McWade said the sale of Amana is not a done deal, and he declined to say whether BSGH was among the 10 prospective buyers.
The appliance group, which includes the Amana, Speed Queen, UniMac and Huebsch brands and employs 8,000, had 1996 revenues of some $1.5 billion.
